\tabnotes{The dependent variable is the one-year US-dollar excess return
  \eqref{eq:rx-usd} earned by a United States investor who holds the foreign
  $n$-year bond unhedged, $n\in\{2,5,10\}$ years. The return is regressed on
  the unadjusted global Cochrane--Piazzesi factor $\GCP_{t}$ and, separately,
  on the FX-adjusted global factor $\mathit{FXGCP}_{t}$, constructed top-down
  on the GDP-weighted average dollar return in the manner of
  \Cref{sec:fw-fxgcf}. The euro pair uses German bonds; all other pairs use
  the respective own market. $t$-statistics in parentheses are Newey--West
  adjusted ($12$ lags); adjusted $R^{2}$ reported. The table replicates
  \citet{dahlquist2013}, Table~7.}
